fixture: Whole original prepared 4032-node undamaged target; actual fixed-mount robot initialized with bounded 2mm/s downward or reversed coasting velocity. Native bounded gravity feedforward, all implicit gains zero, original mass/inertia/effort/target/material/contact gates.
exchange: Actual robot pose held per coupling block, no extrapolated geometry. All accepted target fine-step opposite impulses accumulated; apply their average once at actual knifeCOM. Then real PhysX advances, end-pose contact potential recomputed. Both delay and geometry-jump work retained.
whole_contact_signal_definition: max(initial positive contact potential, maxabs cumulative target pressure work, maxabs cumulative actual robot contact work), excludes initial robot kinetic and target gravity/bulk baselines.
energy_error: Maxabs whole defect AND max(abs(whole defect-signed remap)+cumulativeABSremap) separately must fit contact signal budget. Include actual float32 applied wrench in robot work.
clear_control_energy_budget: 1e-6 times initial robot kinetic energy +1e-15J, both robot and whole assembly, since clear has no contact signal. This is a separate nonzero-speed control precision check, not added to loaded-contact budgets.
no_feedback_scope: Intentional one-way negative control; not required to conserve a closed target+robot contact system.
physical_stop_budgets: Original mounted whole-target force/moment/penetration/board/volume/domain/source-motion/speed/fixture/forbidden-body/nodal impulse gates unchanged.
additional_moving_gate: Actual tool pose change must exceed0.5micrometre; loaded work must exceed1e-10J. Initial native body velocity must equal actual J*written qd. No setup step hidden from accounting.
qualification_scope: Only bounded undamaged coasting moving-contact fixture. Not an executed route, controlled cut, generalized contact/CCD guarantee, live history transaction, release or learning baseline. Complete23B remains open until controller-enabled/disabled routes, reversed/off-centre cases and all fixture gates are independently checked.
